decision_statement: Award the fleet maintenance contract (36 months) to bidder B for 1,062,000 EUR excl. VAT (843 EUR per vehicle per year), ranked first on the weighted criteria (price 60, service 40).
context_at_decision: Four bids received by 2026-05-29: A 1,236,000 EUR (981 per vehicle per year), B 1,062,000 (843), C 1,004,000 (797), D 1,318,000 (1,046). The assistant's analysis flagged C as abnormally low on parts (parts priced 31 % under the DECP median); C's written explanation (2026-06-09) did not account for the parts price, so C was rejected as abnormally low after the adversarial procedure. B scores 60/60 on price among the remaining bids and 34/40 on service (response time 4 h, replacement vehicles). Estimate was 1,140,000 EUR.
options_considered: Award to B at 1,062,000 EUR (chosen): first on the weighted criteria once C is rejected; 7 % under the estimate, 25 % under the current spend.
Award to C at 1,004,000 EUR: lowest price, but abnormally low on parts and the explanation does not hold; the risk is unpaid parts and a failed contract.
Award to A at 1,236,000 EUR: best service score (38/40) but 16 % above B and 8 % above the estimate.
Declare the procedure unsuccessful and join the purchasing group (940 EUR): more expensive than B.
required_inputs_used: The four bids as opened (2026-05-29), price schedules included
Analysis report of 2026-06-15 (criteria, scores, abnormally-low check against DECP medians)
assumptions_depended_on: B's price schedule holds for 36 months under the revision formula of the contract.
success_criteria: Notification within 15 days of the award.
Actual spend at 12 months at or below 354,000 EUR (one third of the award), on the invoice ledger.

affirmation_record.method: signed approval in the procurement console

mode_classification_attestation.attestation_text_signed: I attest that this decision record was dispatched in mode-1 with an embedded mode-2 summary under charter CH-METROPOLE-ACHATS-2026: the purchasing assistant (achats-assistant, version 2) drafted the analysis of the four bids and the abnormally-low check; the commission heard C's explanation; I reviewed the four options recorded here, approved the award to B, and I am the accountable owner of this decision in my capacity as an employee of the Métropole.

re_decision_trigger: A rejected bidder's challenge; B's withdrawal; or the 12-month review.
